Name: Jotham, Son of Gideon
Summary: Jotham, Gideon's youngest son and the only brother to escape Abimelech's massacre, stood on Mount Gerizim and told the parable of the trees choosing a king, then fled to Beer.
KeyStory: Jotham alone hid from the slaughter at Ophrah, climbed Gerizim, and cried out the fable of the trees anointing the bramble — a warning Shechem ignored — then fled and dwelt in Beer.
LifeLesson: One survivor's parable outlived the king it warned against.
